title_en: Sir Reginald and the Clockwork Heart Is an Adventurous Graphic Novel That Combines the Best of Hellboy and DuckTales
summary_en: If the prospect of a graphic novel inspired by Hellboy and DuckTales sounds appealing, check out our exclusive preview of Sir Reginald and the Clockwork Heart.
body_en:
Sir Reginald and the Clockwork Heart is a new graphic novel that's billed as a pulp-flavored mashup of Hellboy and Duck Tails. That elevator pitch alone is enough to have us very intrigued. The fact that it's also a jam piece featuring some of the most talented artists in the comics industry is just icing on the cake.
With the Kickstarter campaign for Sir Reginald and the Clockwork Heart in the pre-launch stage now, IGN can exclusively debut a preview of writer Joe Atalla and artist Juni Ba's story "The Curse of Osiris." Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Sir Reginald and the Clockwork Heart is a 96-page graphic novel that features five stories in all, each of which is written by Atalla. Other artists include Atalla, Jesse Lonergan, Dimitrios Pantazis, and Armand Bodnar. Here's the official description of the book:
“Sir Reginald and the Clockwork Heart has everything I think a comic should today - memorable characters, action, adventure, romance, humor and a dash of mystery,” said Atalla in a statement. “Beneath this lies a fiercely beating heart that will make you question yourself by the end of the story. I'm so proud of what my collaborators and I have created. These stories have something for everyone.”
The Kickstarter campaign for Sir Reginald and the Clockwork Heart is in pre-launch now.
For more, check out our exclusive preview of Image Comics' Decidium Returned and get the full scoop on the dramatic events of The Amazing Spider-Man #1000 .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
